name: 3x Strength Week
title: Lift three or more times per week.
benefit: Real strength gains and better physical resilience.
subtitle: Strength Volume
rationale: Three or more structured sessions progress strength rather than merely maintaining it.

evidence.summary: Multiple weekly strength exposures support strength and muscle development when paired with sufficient training volume.

indications: Two weekly sessions are established and recovery is solid.
Progression, not maintenance, is the goal.
